description: US FDIC-insured banks (FDIC BankFind call-report data): name, FDIC cert, Fed RSSD ID, location, total assets, deposits and net income (USD), ROA and ROE, report date, charter class, regulator, office counts, holding company, website, established date, active flag and closing date. Search by name, filter by state and active status, sort by assets, deposits, name or age; or look up one bank by cert. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

active.description: true (default) for active banks, false for closed/merged ones, all for both

cert.description: Optional FDIC certificate number for one bank

name.description: Optional words of the bank name, e.g. Chase, Frost
